svg.title: Memory tiers for the ID tracker
svg.desc: The ID tracker, which maps point IDs to their internal locations, can be set per collection to pinned, held in RAM, which is the default; cached, loaded into the page cache when a segment opens and evictable; or cold, read from disk. Toward RAM gives faster lookups; toward disk uses less RAM.
